Connectors
Connect Gmail and Outlook

With a mailbox connected, %1$s can read, tidy and draft your mail, find your contacts and see your calendar. Before sending, replying, or adding, changing or deleting an event, it always shows you a card to confirm. You can connect several mailboxes.

Signing in in Orbit\'s browser keeps Orbit signed in to that account when it uses the browser. Sign-in credentials are kept encrypted on this phone only. Mail goes straight between this phone and Google or Microsoft, through no relay server.
Where to sign in?
The sign-in page asks for mail, contacts and calendar. Allow them all so Orbit can find contacts and see and plan your calendar.
